rules.title: Prohibition on landlord application fees and pre-tenancy charges
rules.quote: It states that prior to the beginning of a tenancy, no lessor may require payment for anything except first, last, security, and locks (MGL Ch 186 Section 15B).
rules.summary: Landlords may not charge application fees or any other pre-tenancy charges except first month's rent, last month's rent, security deposit, and lock-change fee.
rules.exemption_note: Licensed brokers may charge application fees under 254 CMR 7
rules.penalty: Treble damages and attorney's fees (federal district court awarded in Perry v Equity Residential Management, LLC, 2014)

rules.title: Broker application fee requirements
rules.quote: The board's regulations set out certain detailed requirements, including the steps that a licensed broker must take when dealing with prospective tenants (254 C.M.R. 7).
rules.summary: Licensed brokers may charge application fees to prospective tenants if they comply with board of registration regulations, including written disclosure requirements.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to licensed brokers only; broker must provide written notice of fee amount, time and manner of payment, and whether contingent on lease execution at first personal meeting with applicant
rules.exemption_note: Broker must hold valid license; landlord-brokers likely cannot charge fees when acting as landlord
